tr: Li rūḥī wa khalliṣ min siwāka `uqūlanā
en: O King, take charge of all that I do – For my soul, purify my thoughts of other than You

ar: وَقَدِّسْ أَيَا قُدُّوْسُ نَفْسِيْ مِنَ الْهَوَى
tr: Wa qaddis Ayā Quddūsu nafsī mina ‘l-hawā
Wa sallim jamī`ī Yā Salāmu mina ‘ḍ-ḍanā
en: And sanctify O Holy, my self from whim – And safeguard my entirety, O Safeguarder from exhaustion

ar: وَ يَا مُؤْمِنُ هَبْ لِيْ أَمَانًا وَبَهْجَةً
tr: Wa Yā Mu’minu hab lī amānan wa bahjatan
Wa jammil janānī Yā Muhayminu bi ‘l-munā
en: O Faithful bestow upon me safety and delight – And beautify my insides O Preserver, with longing

ar: وَجُدْ لِيْ بعِزٍّ يَا عَزِيْزُ وَقُوَّةٍ
tr: Wa jud lī bi `izzin Yā `Azīzu wa quwwatin
en: Lavish me with honor, O Mighty, and power – With might O Compeller, disperse our enemies
blocks.review: بعِزٍّ: no kasra visible under the bāʾ (translit bi); transcribed without it.

tr: Wa kabbir shu’ūnī fīka Yā Mutakabbiru
en: Enhance my affairs with You O Supreme – O Creator of Existences, inundate us with abundance
blocks.review: شُءُوْنِيْ: printed with a single wāw and the hamza (with ḍamma) floating above the shīn–wāw join, encoded with standalone ء as on p115.
